chunks: So when they saw it as a cloud advancing towards their valleys, they said: 'This is just a passing cloud that will bring us rain.' 'No. It is what you were trying to hasten: The wind which carries the grievous punishment!'

key_terms.عَارِضٌ: a passing cloud or mass of clouds

ai.seo_question: What did the people of Hud mistake the wind of punishment for?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of *istiqbal* (anticipation) where the disbelievers projected their desires onto reality, mistaking the *Rih al-'Adhim* for a blessing. It underscores the irony of their haste, as the very punishment they mocked arrived in a form they initially welcomed, serving as a timeless warning against superficial judgment of divine signs.
